label: LTX-2.5 + MSR (up to four people and the place as pictures)
_note: One shot a generation: no multishot form. A run of shots as one prompt cut on its own, but put people in shots they weren't in and doubled others on the script's own wording (docs/MULTISHOT.md, 'LTX MSR revisited'); as single shots it holds them.

capabilities._note: max_subjects: the MSR guide's four picture slots (pic1-pic4); the place is a fifth, its background slot.

template._note: LTX-2 renders 8k+1 frames. Two stages, as Licon's sample: a base pass at half size, then the x2 latent upsampler and a refine, so the output is a multiple of 64. The final is 1664x960 (the base pass 832x480, the size MSR was measured at: smaller, a face in a three-shot is a few latent cells); sizes that aren't legal are snapped down, then shrunk under 1664 on the long side and 1.6 MP.

recipe._note: Licon's MSR LoRA (LiconStudio/LTX-2.5-Multiple-Subject-Reference, V2) through ComfyUI-LTX2.5-MSR's loader and Multi-Reference Guide, prompted with kijai's ComfyUI-PromptRelay, two stages, as the pack's V2 sample workflow (no audio references). The pictures (`references`) are composed at queue time: each person or thing a 16:9 sheet on grey at the render size, as MSR's own validation pictures are (a tall full-length picture reached the guide with a face of a few latent cells: it fits a picture whole into the frame), and the place's plate as the background. All are required, like H3's pictures; rendering anyway leaves the missing ones out and renumbers the prompt's `Image N`. The prompt is two parts (prompt.py): the global one names each picture (`Image 1: the Stepmother, ...`) and the look, the local one is the scene with each pictured person called by their picture. LTX makes the soundtrack with the picture, unless the shot is a dub: then the shot's window of the recorded track is held as the whole soundtrack through every stage and the picture is made to it (targets/held_audio.py; measured live 2026-10-28, docs/PLAN.md 'LTX dub'). dub_keep_foley holds the same window, so its foley bed is near silent. clone renders with generate and says so.

policy_fallback.why: LTX-2 takes a recording to dub to, but not yet a voice sample to clone

references._note: A character's sheet: a strip (wider than `strip_ratio`, the series' 4-panel sheet) gives its `views` side by side, the full body, the face and the back, as Licon's; one whole picture gives itself and a face: the picture of a variant of it named for its face (`<id>_face`, or the variant the shot names when its person's own picture is full length), else `face_box` of the picture (fractions: the head of a full-length portrait). A prop or vehicle is its picture alone.

size_hints.character sheet: a 4-panel strip, or one full-length picture (with a `<id>_face` variant for the face)
size_hints.background plate: 16:9 (the guide crops it to the frame)

binding._note: The workflow is an API graph (workflow.json): stage 1 of Licon's V2 sample (UNETLoader -> MSR loader -> PromptRelayEncode -> LTXVConditioning -> Multi-Reference Guide -> CFGGuider, 8 steps of euler_ancestral on the distilled schedule) and its stage 2 (LTXVLatentUpsampler x2, a second PromptRelay and Guide at the new size, LTXVDualCFGGuider, stage 1's audio held), the refine started at 0.6, not the sample's 0.85, which redrew faces stage 1 had right (two seeds, 2026-10-26). H3SaveShot takes the place of CreateVideo/SaveVideo. patch_graph puts the composed pictures into both guides' slots.

models._note: As ltx2's (LTX-2.5 split files), with the MSR LoRA, required: it is what reads the pictures. The distilled transformer only: the workflow's fixed 8-step schedule at cfg 1 is the distilled model's, as Licon's sample runs it.

presets._note: LTX-2.5 22B distilled (int8) with the MSR LoRA at 1.0: stage 1 at half size, 8 steps at cfg 1; stage 2 at full size, 3 steps from 0.6. The final is 1664x960 (stage 1 at 832x480, the size MSR was tried at); the proxy 1152x640. The negative prompt is the sample's: MSR's card says it matters.

final.negative: subtitles, watermark, worst quality, blurry, jittery, distorted, inconsistent appearance

proxy.negative: subtitles, watermark, worst quality, blurry, jittery, distorted, inconsistent appearance

downloads._note: Where to get each file this target names (docs/API.md 'Downloads'). A url is only given when a trustworthy record has it; `source` says which. Never a guessed URL.
